about: Held-out pairs for the claim-stance rules, round 1. Written after the first version of the rules and scored once before anything was changed: 33 of 40 right, 4 passages wrongly counted as supporting. The rules were then changed for the general classes it exposed (irregular opposite verbs, numbers written as words, 'X, not Y,' asides, open questions, a clause about someone else covering most of the words, hedges beside a negation), so this file is now development data and its score says nothing about new text. See stance_heldout_round2.json for the current held-out round.
